sn22.82:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāramātupāsāde mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ || || 2
sn22.82:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā tadahuposathe pannarase puṇṇamāya rattiyā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto ajjhokāse nisinno hoti || || 3
sn22.82:2.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena Bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn22.82:2.2: Puccheyyāham bhante Bhagavantaṃ kiñcid eva desaṃ sace me Bhagavā okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyāti || ||
sn22.82:2.3: Tena hi tvaṃ bhikkhu sake āsane nisīditvā puccha yad ākaṅkhasīti || || 4
sn22.82:2.4: Evam bhante ti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato paṭissutvā sake āsane nisīditvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn22.82:2.5: Ime nu kho bhante pañcupādānakkhandhā || seyyathīdaṃ
sn22.82:3.3: Sādhu bhante ti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā Bhagavantam uttarim pañham apucchi || ||
sn22.82:4.1: Ime kho pana bhante pañcupādānakkhandhā kimmūlakā ti || ||
sn22.82:4.2: Ime kho bhikkhu pañcupādānakkhandhā chandamūlakā ti || || 6 Pa ||
sn22.82:4.3: Taññeva nu kho bhante upādānaṃ te pañcupādānakkhandhā udāhu aññatra pañcupādānakkhandehi upādānan ti || ||
sn22.82:4.4: Na kho bhikkhu taññeva upādānaṃ te pañcupādānakkhandhā nāpi aññatra pañcupādānakkhandehi upādānaṃ || api ca yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādānan ti || || 7
sn22.82:4.5: Sādhu bhante ti kho so bhikkhu || la || uttarim pañhaṃ apucchi || ||
sn22.82:5.1: Siyā pana bhante pañcupādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavemattatā ti || ||
sn22.82:5.4: Evaṃrūpo siyam anāgatam addhānaṃ || evaṃvedano siyam anāgatam addhānaṃ || evaṃsaññī siyam anāgatam addhānaṃ || evaṃsaṅkhāro siyaṃ anāgatam addhānaṃ || evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatam addhānaṃ || ||
sn22.82:5.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu siyā pañcupādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavemattatā ti || || 8
sn22.82:5.6: Sādhu bhante ti kho so bhikkhu || pe || uttariṃ pañham apucchi || ||
sn22.82:6.1: Kittāvatā nu kho khandhānaṃ khandhādhivacanan ti || ||
sn22.82:6.2: Yaṃ kiñci bhikkhave rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā ayaṃ vuccati rūpakkhandho ||
sn22.82:6.6: yaṃ kiñci viññāṇam atītānāgatapaccuppannam ajjhattam vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā ayaṃ vuccati viññāṇakkhandho || ||
sn22.82:6.7: Ettāvatā kho bhikkhu khandhānaṃ khandhādhivacanan ti || || 9
sn22.82:6.8: Sādhu bhante ti kho so bhikkhu || pe || apucchi || ||
sn22.82:7.1: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo rūpakkhandhassa paññāpanāya ||
sn22.82:7.2: Ko hetu ko paccayo vedanākkhandhassa paññāpanāya ||
sn22.82:7.3: Ko hetu ko paccayo saññākkhandhassa paññāpanāya ||
sn22.82:7.4: Ko hetu ko paccayo saṅkhārakkhandhassa paññāpanāya ||
sn22.82:7.5: Ko hetu ko paccayo viññāṇakkhandhassa paññāpanāyāti || ||
sn22.82:7.6: Cattāro kho bhikkhu mahābhūtā hetu cattāro mahābhūtā paccayo rūpakkhandhassa paññāpanāya || ||
sn22.82:7.7: Phasso hetu phassa paccayo vedanākkhandhassa paññāpanāya ||
sn22.82:7.8: phasso hetu phasso paccayo saññākkhandhassa paññāpanāya ||
sn22.82:7.9: phasso hetu phasso paccayo saṅkhārakkhandhassa paññāpanāya || ||
sn22.82:7.10: Nāmarūpaṃ hetu nāmarūpam paccayo viññāṇakkhandhassa paññāpanāyāti || || 10
sn22.82:7.11: Sādhu bhante ti kho so bhikkhu || pe || apucchi || ||
sn22.82:8.1: Kathaṃ nu kho bhante sakkāyadiṭṭhi hotīti || ||
sn22.82:8.2: Idha bhikkhu assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto
sn22.82:8.3: rūpam attato samanupassati || rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ ||
sn22.82:8.7: viññāṇam attato samanupassati || viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānam attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ || ||
sn22.82:8.8: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu sakkāya diṭṭhi hotīti || || 11
sn22.82:8.9: Sādhu bhante ti kho so bhikkhu || pe || apucchi || ||
sn22.82:9.1: Katham pana bhante sakkāyadiṭṭhi na hotīti || ||
sn22.82:9.2: Idha bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sapurisaddhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto
sn22.82:9.3: na rūpam attato samanupassati || na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā rūpaṃ na rūpasmiṃ vā attānam || ||
sn22.82:9.7: na viññāṇam attato samanupassati || na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā viññānaṃ na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attanaṃ || ||
sn22.82:9.8: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu sakkāyadiṭṭhi na hotīti || || 12
sn22.82:9.9: Sādhu bhante ti kho so bhikkhu || pe || apucchi || ||
sn22.82:10.1: Ko nu kho bhante rūpassa assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ ||
sn22.82:10.5: ko viññāṇassa assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇan ti || ||
sn22.82:10.6: Yaṃ kho bhikkhu rūpaṃ paticca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ ayaṃ rūpassa assādo ||
sn22.82:10.7: yaṃ rūpam aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammam ayaṃ rūpassa ādīnavo ||
sn22.82:10.8: yo rūpasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgapahānaṃ idaṃ rūpassa nissaraṇaṃ || ||
sn22.82:10.12: Yaṃ viññāṇam paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ ayaṃ viññāṇassa assādo ||
sn22.82:10.13: yaṃ viññāṇam aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ ayaṃ viññāṇassa ādīnavo ||
sn22.82:10.14: yo viññāṇasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgapahānaṃ idaṃ viññāṇassa nissaraṇan ti || || 13
sn22.82:10.15: Sādhu bhante ti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā Bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañham apucchi || ||
sn22.82:11.1: Kathaṃ nu kho bhante jānato kathaṃ passato imasmim ca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṅkāramamaṅkāramānānusayā na hontīti || ||
sn22.82:11.2: Yaṃ kiñci bhikkhu rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannam ajjhattam vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīṇaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā || yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ rūpaṃ netaṃ mama neso ham asmi na meso attā ti || || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati || ||
sn22.82:11.6: Yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannam ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā panītaṃ vā || yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attā ti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati || ||
sn22.82:11.7: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evam passato imasmiṃ ca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṅkāramamaṅkāramānānusayā na hontīti || || 14
sn22.82:12.1: Tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || ||
sn22.82:12.2: Iti kira bho rūpam anattā || vedanā || saññā || saṅkhārā || viññāṇam anattā ||
sn22.82:12.4: Atha kho Bhagavā tassa bhikkhuno cetasā ceto parivitakkaṃ aññāya bhikkhū āmantesi || ||
sn22.82:13.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ idhekacco moghapuriso avidvā avijjāgato taṇhādhipateyyena cetasā satthusāsanaṃ atidhāvitabbaṃ maññeyya || ||
sn22.82:13.2: Iti kira bho rūpam anattā || vedanā || saññā || saṅkhārā || viññāṇaṃ anattā
sn22.82:13.4: Paṭipucchā vinītā kho me tumhe bhikkhave tatra tatra tesu dhammesu || || 16
sn22.82:14.2: Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.82:14.7: Viññāṇam niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.82:14.9: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.82:14.11: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ || ||
sn22.82:14.12: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me āttāti || ||
sn22.82:16.4: Pārileyyena Puṇṇamāti || || 1 Evam me sutaṃ || ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Ānando Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2
